procedural_matters: FRA 95 was represented by Emile Amoros (crew).
The race committee was represented by Anne Malledant (PRO).
facts: The ARMS system had a failure between races 1 and 2 of the 49er red fleet.

FRA 95 requested redress because she was dissatisfied that the race committee did not use the ARMS system for race 2 of the 49er red fleet, while it was used by the race committee for the other 49er fleets.

Addendum "ARMS" of the Sailing Instructions - Olympic events - Kieler Woche 2026 states that: “Alleged failure, inaccuracy or malfunction of the ARMS device or ARMS system will not be grounds for requesting redress. This changes RRS 61.1(a).”.
conclusions: FRA 95 is not entitled to request redress on the grounds of an alleged failure of the ARMS system, as stated in Olympic Event SI Addendum ARMS 9.
The panel of the international jury could not proceed any further.
